## Summary
- refresh the Phase 0 stable-release aggregate to current main after PR #730
- replace the stale after-727 evidence bundle with after-730 source, PR, workflow, gate-summary, and checksum artifacts
- keep Phase 0 blocked/open and record PR #728/#730 as source/test hardening only, not Host-backed product evidence

## Verification
- `make phase0-module-ownership-gate PHASE0_MODULE_OWNERSHIP_SUMMARY=docs/changes/2026-08-22-phase0-stable-release-aggregate/evidence/2026-09-09-after-730-current-main-gate-blocked/phase0-module-ownership-summary.json`

- `shasum -a 256 -c docs/changes/2026-08-22-phase0-stable-release-aggregate/evidence/2026-09-09-after-730-current-main-gate-blocked/SHA256SUMS`
- `git diff --check`

## Notes
- Main push workflow snapshots for commit `20776920b46bf6d4d6a33789cc3e0d1cb9ba1e1c` were retained as observed during this refresh; iOS and HarmonyOS were successful, while Phase 0 checks were still in progress at snapshot time.
- No Vibe Screen, MacHost, or Telemachus GUI was launched.
- No `swift run`, Screen Recording, Accessibility, Microphone, Keychain, TCC, System Settings, signing change, or `adb reverse` setup was used.
- Phase 0 remains blocked: `can_mark_phase0_stable_release=false`.
